source_metadata.title: In Vivo Base Editing of PCSK9 with VERVE-102 for Hypercholesterolemia
source_metadata.source_note: Primary PDF only. The article references a Supplementary Appendix, protocol, statistical analysis plan, disclosure forms, and data sharing statement, but none were listed as companion materials for this task and they were not silently imported.

extraction_limitations: Only the primary article PDF was analyzed; source-referenced supplementary/protocol materials were not provided as companions.
The interim analysis was nonprespecified and performed no formal statistical testing; atoms preserve reported descriptive ranges rather than inferential estimates.
No atom converts the authors’ cardiovascular-risk projection into an observed clinical outcome.
No unreported off-target editing rates or detailed eligibility criteria were inferred from references to supplementary material.
